ArchitectureNotes.objective: Bidirectional real-time voice translation with minimal latency and reliable fallback chain.
ArchitectureNotes.non-goal: Cloud deployment, multi-user support, browser-based STT.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-1: Deepgram WS instability (error 10054) causes STT gaps. Mitigated by Whisper fallback.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-2: WASAPI COM references from device enumeration can block pipeline audio capture.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-3: Echo feedback through CABLE if meeting app misconfigured (speaker must be CABLE Input).

contract.purpose: Pipeline orchestrator: manages outgoing/incoming audio pipelines, STT→Translate→TTS chain

DF-OUTGOING.NAME: Outgoing Pipeline (RU→EN)
DF-OUTGOING.step-1: Capture audio from Jabra mic via WASAPI (cpal)
DF-OUTGOING.step-2: Resample to 16kHz, send to Deepgram WebSocket Deepgram returns STT transcript (or Whisper fallback) Translate via Groq/LiteLLM/Yandex Synthesize English TTS via Piper Play through CABLE Input → meeting app → conference pipeline_trace.log: [outgoing] STT/TRANSLATE/PLAYBACK/METRICS events

DF-INCOMING.NAME: Incoming Pipeline (EN→RU)
DF-INCOMING.step-1: Capture audio from CABLE Output (remote audio from meeting app)
DF-INCOMING.step-2: Resample to 16kHz, send to Deepgram WebSocket (or Whisper) STT transcript returned Translate English → Russian via Groq/LiteLLM/Yandex Synthesize Russian TTS via Piper Play through Jabra speakers pipeline_trace.log: [incoming] STT/TRANSLATE/PLAYBACK/METRICS events

DF-CONFIG.NAME: Configuration Flow
DF-CONFIG.TRIGGER: User saves settings in Flask UI
DF-CONFIG.step-1: User edits settings in Flask web UI (http://127.0.0.1:5050)
DF-CONFIG.step-3: Elixir reads settings, passes as env vars to Rust engine
DF-CONFIG.step-4: Engine restarts pipelines with new config
DF-CONFIG.evidence: settings.json changes, engine restart in elixir_console.log

DF-FALLBACK.NAME: STT Fallback Chain
DF-FALLBACK.step-2: After 3 disconnections, switch to Yandex SpeechKit
DF-FALLBACK.step-3: If Yandex unavailable, switch to local Whisper (small model)
DF-FALLBACK.evidence: pipeline_trace.log: Switching to Yandex/Whisper STT messages
